versions.shortDescription: Scalable clustering with scikit-learn BIRCH (CF tree), suitable for larger tabular datasets.
versions.longDescription: This app runs scikit-learn's Birch (Balanced Iterative Reducing and Clustering using Hierarchies). It builds a CF tree controlled by threshold and branching_factor and can optionally perform a final global clustering step (n_clusters). Outputs include cluster labels per sample, subcluster centers from the CF tree, and a compact HTML report summarizing parameters and resulting cluster/subcluster statistics.

hyperparams.name: threshold
hyperparams.description: Radius threshold for merging subclusters (smaller => more clusters/subclusters).

hyperparams.name: branching_factor
hyperparams.description: Maximum number of CF subclusters in each node of the CF tree.

hyperparams.name: use_global_clustering
hyperparams.description: If true, run a final global clustering step; if false, set n_clusters=None (no global clustering).

hyperparams.name: n_clusters
hyperparams.description: Number of clusters for the final global clustering step (used only if use_global_clustering=true).

hyperparams.name: compute_labels
hyperparams.description: Whether to compute labels for each sample after fitting.

hyperparams.name: copy
hyperparams.description: Whether to make a copy of the input matrix X before fitting.

hyperparams.name: standardize
hyperparams.description: Standardize features to zero mean / unit variance before clustering (recommended).

input.name: features
input.description: Tabular feature matrix. Rows = samples, columns = numeric features. If you have an ID column, place it as the first column named id; otherwise sample indices will be used.

output.name: labels
output.description: Cluster assignments per sample. Columns: [id?, label]. If no 'id' column was provided, 'index' is used.

output.name: subcluster_centers
output.description: Centers of BIRCH subclusters (subcluster_centers_). Rows=subclusters, columns=features.

output.name: report
output.description: Lightweight HTML summary with params, number of subclusters, and cluster size statistics.
